description:
Exact geodesic distance between two places or geometries on the WGS84 ellipsoid.

        Use for any "how far" question instead of estimating. For NAMED places pass place_a and
        place_b; the server geocodes them, so never type coordinates for a place yourself. Use
        point_a/point_b only for coordinates the user gave or another tool returned. For lines
        and polygons the distance is between their nearest points. Returns metres and kilometres.

place_a.description: A place NAME, e.g. 'Adelaide Oval'; geocoded on the server (preferred)
place_a.title: Place A

place_b.description: A place NAME, e.g. 'Adelaide Oval'; geocoded on the server (preferred)
place_b.title: Place B

point_a.description: A GeoJSON geometry, e.g. {"type": "Point", "coordinates": [lon, lat]}; only for coordinates the user gave or a tool returned
point_a.title: Point A

point_b.description: A GeoJSON geometry, e.g. {"type": "Point", "coordinates": [lon, lat]}; only for coordinates the user gave or a tool returned
point_b.title: Point B

name: calculate_distance

places.description: Named places as geocoded on the server: query, display_name, coordinates [lon, lat]
places.title: Places

provenance.description: Source, licence, attribution, retrieval time and method
provenance.title: Provenance
